text_block_list.text:
The morning of the Falcon Stakes had 
finally arrived. On the way to the venue 
from the inn we stayed at the night 
before—

text_block_list.name: Man in a Suit
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, did I leave the presentation 
materials back at the office!? Bad, bad, 
bad...!!
choice_data_list: Ah?! Hey, that bag is mine...!
Ah?! Excuse me, that bag is mine...!

text_block_list.text:
Good grief, my bag got swapped with 
someone else's! It contains a mountain of 
crucial documents that are essential for 
entering the race...!
choice_data_list:
I'll go get it back! Go on ahead to the 
venue!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Understood.

"I quickly chase after the suited back 
that rushed away in quite a panic, but—"

text_block_list.name: Passersby
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa, what's with all these people?!" "I 
heard the traffic light broke down~" 
"Ouch! Hey, someone just shoved me~?!"

The other runner threads skillfully 
through the gap, but that opening closes 
in an instant, leaving no room to pursue!
――Are you in need of assistance?

I turned around, and there stood Durandal! 
She's usually seen around Believe, a sharp 
and poised Umamusume, but—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Are you pursuing that gentleman in the 
suit? If so—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
In this moment, I am your shield. Your 
sword. I shall carve open the path. —Come!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Coming through! Excuse me! Coming through! 
Excuse meee!!

And with her broad vision and quick 
footwork, Durandal deftly sliced open a 
path for usâ

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
You helped get my bag back, didn't you? 
...Thank you very much.

I had heard rumors, but... it truly was a 
dependability worthy of being called a 
'Knight.' I bow deeply, expressing my 
gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Please, raise your head, Trainer. I only 
did what was natural.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I, Durandal, have merely followed the 
knight's oath sworn upon my heart. Please, 
pay it no mind!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: ......Fufufu!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Stepping in to help on a split-second 
decision is wonderful. You should take 
more pride in that, Durandal.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"It's plainly written all over your face 
anyway, so you might as well celebrate 
from the bottom of your heart. Shall I 
cheer 'hooray' along with you?"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
You don't need to say another word! Wait, 
who are you calling an open book?! Who?!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"It's you. Here we go. Yaaay! I got 
praised! Woohoo!"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: I'm not doing it!!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"Calstone-san, Durandal-san. It's carrying 
over to next door... Please keep it down."

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
"I-I am so sorry..." "Right, my 
apologies."
choice_data_list:
(So Believe is the one keeping everyone 
together...)

(So Believe is the one keeping everyone 
together, huh...)

text_block_list.text:
Even so, they seem to get along pretty 
well. Did Durandal come here to cheer on 
Believe and the others?

If so, it's rather endearing. ...Just as I 
was thinking that—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: "*Ahem*! ...In any case, you two."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Today, I will ascertain for myself— where 
you all truly stand.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, no matter how far ahead they 
might be—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
This blade will surely reach your throats 
one day.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
—For there is nothing that the holy sword 
within me cannot sever.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
No. I won't let them cut me down. I won't 
let them catch up. No one will ever reach 
my back.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I am fast. Faster than anyone. Surpassing 
all living things, the wind, and even 
light itself.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Just faster. Just faster. Just faster.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: I will run and prove it. —That is all.

The atmosphere changed all of a sudden. 
Tensing up involuntarily... I realized 
what it meant.

Yes, each of them possesses a "speed"— one 
they strive to master.

—Durandal. To her, it was sharpness. A 
finishing burst as razor-sharp as a 
blade—that was her speed.

—Calstone Light O. For her, it is top 
speed. A speed that transcends even the 
limits of an Umamusume—that is her true 
speed.

And then, Believe. For her, it's stamina. 
Enduring to the bitter end and holding on 
is her kind of speed.

Three individuals with completely 
different kinds of "speed"— are now about 
to clash in the very same era.

The one clashing directly in today's 
Falcon Stakes is Calstone Light O. But 
seeing that spectacle, Durandal too will 
surely sharpen his blade.

In other words, today's match will 
undoubtedly be one of the races that 
decides what's to come.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...It's time. I'm heading out.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: As for who is "fast"—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Let's decide this with a run.
